core_obligations: Show that any restriction, base change, flat pullback, or proper pushforward of a relative r-cycle is a relative r-cycle (proof lines 972-977). Flat pullback: lemma-specialization-flat-pullback (tag 0H4L) (proof line 973). Restriction: special case of flat pullback along the flat morphism of relative dimension 0 given by an open immersion (proof lines 974-975). Base change: base change is transitive, so the specialization condition for the base-changed family along any DVR morphism of the new base is the base change of the specialization condition for the original family along the composite, which holds by hypothesis (proof line 975). Proper pushforward: lemma-specialization-proper-pushforward (tag 0H4M) (proof line 976).
proof_roadmap: Flat pullback and restriction by the specialization-flat-pullback lemma (proof lines 973-975).
Base change by transitivity of base change (proof line 975).
Proper pushforward by the specialization-proper-pushforward lemma (proof line 976).
